question: Can solid-state batteries realistically replace conventional lithium-ion batteries? What do published studies, computed materials data, and deposited research datasets actually support?
purpose: Interview gold-path pins for live MCP hits on all three servers. Tests never call these APIs; operators confirm via scripts/mcp_live_smoke.py / DEMO.md.

literature.title_hint: A lithium superionic conductor (Li10GeP2S12) — Kamaya et al., Nature Materials 2011
literature.why: Canonical sulfide SSE landmark paper; DOI resolves on OpenAlex (via doi:) and Crossref.

materials_project.why: Computed Li-ion cathode baseline for the replace-Li-ion question; never treat as experimental/commercial proof.

pubchem.why: Battery-relevant compound metadata via PubChem (distinct from Materials Project computed records).

zenodo.why: Deposited dataset PID; Investigator fetch path for research-data MCP.

datacite.why: Same dataset PID via DataCite (Verifier independent re-fetch path — see RoadMap 9.3).
